subject: [PATCH v5 04/22] iomap: use GFP_NOWAIT when application for iomap_dio_simple allocations

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch modifies the allocation of memory for non-blocking direct I/O operations in the Linux kernel's iomap module to use GFP_NOWAIT instead of GFP_KERNEL. This change is intended to prevent blocking allocations when possible, improving performance for applications that require non-blocking I/O. The modification affects the __iomap_dio_read_simple function and involves changing the allocation flags used by bio_alloc_bioset.
